name: doors-batch2
description: TEMPLATE (f) v0.31.8.34: second doors batch. Loads tpl-condo-2bed (5 sealed groups -> fully connected) and asserts its new doors exist plus the Open Kitchen pass-through, then screenshots the plan.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-every-room-reachable
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const doors=s.openings.filter(o=>o.kind==='door'); const need=['c2-bed-door','c2-master-door','c2-bal-door']; const missing=need.filter(id=>!doors.find(o=>o.id===id)); if(missing.length) throw new Error('missing doors: '+missing); if(doors.find(o=>o.id==='c2-kit-door')) throw new Error('the Open Kitchen should have a pass-through, not a door'); const kw=s.walls.find(w=>w.id==='c2-kit-n'); if(Math.abs(kw.end[0]-1.5)>0.01) throw new Error('c2-kit-n should stop at x=1.5, got '+kw.end[0]); return doors.length+' doors, kitchen pass-through 1.1 m'})()
